start_here: Say to your AI: "List my Hetzner DNS zones." It runs tool:list-hetzner-dns-zones with the zone name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads or changes your Hetzner DNS zones.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to do, with the zone name and the record values.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; a change is real, so check it with tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets.

worked_examples.title: List my Hetzner DNS zones
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/hetzner-dns/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: GET https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones with the vault key hetzner-api-token as a bearer header, to api.hetzner.cloud only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers each zone with its id, name, mode and nameservers, for example example.com, id 42, mode primary.
